target.build: default; ASan recommended to confirm UAF cleanly

trigger.message: no single PFCP message — the bug is a timing race between node_timeout deleting a smf_sess_t while its PFCP xact is still pending
trigger.field: xact->data pointer in PFCP transaction. When node_timeout removes the session, the pending xact still holds a pointer to the freed session. sess_5gc_timeout (via response_timeout / ogs_timer_mgr_expire) later dereferences this stale pointer and calls smf_sess_remove on already-freed memory -> talloc double-free -> SIGABRT. Textbook PB3 'Invalid Reference' (async callback holds stale object pointer).
trigger.precondition: 5G core running; UE registered + PDU session established; one UPF killed; UE deregistered before node_timeout fires; node_timeout then fires while session-deletion xact is in flight.

ground_truth.crash_type: SIGABRT in ogs_talloc_free (talloc detects free of already-freed memory) — under ASan would surface as heap-use-after-free

root_cause.note: Timer callback holds stale xact->data pointer to a smf_sess_t deleted earlier by node_timeout. The crash manifests in smf_sess_remove -> ogs_talloc_free, but the originating defect is the dangling pointer captured in the xact.
